title: Pegboard adapter plate
prompt: Adapter plate for my pegboard (the standard kind: 1/4" holes on a 1" grid). I'll laser cut it from 4 mm plywood: 90 x 65 mm, with six 7 mm holes for 1/4" bolts in a 3 x 2 grid on the pegboard's 25.4 mm pitch, centred on the plate. Also four M4 clearance holes (4.5 mm), 6 mm in from both edges at each corner, for whatever I mount on it.

hidden_tests.description: Evaluates cleanly and every body is a valid closed solid
90 x 65 mm plate, 4 mm thick, ±0.1 mm
Six 7 mm bolt holes (6.8–7.2) in a 3 x 2 grid on the 25.4 mm (1 inch) pitch
The grid is centred: corner bolt holes 19.6 / 19.8 mm from the edges, middle ones 19.8 / 45 mm
Four M4 clearance holes (4.3–4.6 mm), each 6 mm in from both edges at a corner
Exactly ten holes, nothing else cut out

notes: Pegboard: 1/4 in holes on 1 in centres. 1/4 in bolt (6.35 mm) clearance: 6.75 close / 7.14 normal; 7.0 chosen. Edge offsets: 45 − 25.4 = 19.6, 32.5 − 12.7 = 19.8.
